name: Kunigami (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kunigami village emblem in green and white: a green lozenge outlined in white with a stylised letter C.
history: Municipal flag of Kunigami, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1972.

features.role: Kunigami village emblem — a green lozenge outlined in white with a stylised letter C
